spanish: quemadura debajo de quemadura, herida debajo de herida, magulladura debajo de magulladura.

findings.issue: «debajo de» locks תַּחַת to the spatial sense and closes the substitutive sense (in place of) that the preposition lemma leaves open.

notes: The three singular noun pairs match lemmas 3555, 6482, and 2250 in order and number.
